newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-FIRST ROUND PICKS IN DRAFT.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-FIRST ROUND PICKS IN DRAFT.

text.p: First-round
selections in the 1997 National Basketball Association draft:
1. San Antonio -- Tim Duncan, centre, Wake Forest
2. Philadelphia -- Keith Van Horn, forward, Utah (to be
traded to New Jersey according to unconfirmed reports)
3. Boston -- Chauncey Billups, guard, Colorado
4. Vancouver -- Antonio Daniels, guard, Bowling Green
5. Denver -- Tony Battie, forward-centre, Texas Tech
6. Boston (from Dallas) -- Ron Mercer, forward, Kentucky
7. New Jersey -- Tim Thomas, forward, Villanova (to be
traded to Philadelphia according to unconfirmed reports)
8. Golden State -- Adonal Foyle, forward-centre, Colgate
9. Toronto -- Tracy McGrady, forward, Mt. Zion Academy (high
school)
10. Milwaukee -- Danny Fortson, forward, Cincinnati (traded
to Denver)
11. Sacramento -- Olivier St. Jean, forward, San Jose State
(first NBA draft pick born and raised in France)
12. Indiana -- Austin Croshere, forward, Providence
13. Cleveland -- Derek Anderson, guard, Kentucky
14. Los Angeles Clippers -- Maurice Taylor, forward, Michigan
15. Dallas (from Minnesota) -- Kelvin Cato, centre, Iowa
State (traded to Portland)
16. Cleveland (from Phoenix) -- Brevin Knight, guard,
Stanford
17. Orlando -- Johnny Taylor, forward, Chattanooga
18. Portland -- Chris Anstey, centre, East Melbourne Magic
(Australia) (traded to Dallas) (first Australian picked in
first round since Luc Longley by Minnesota in 1991)
19. Detroit -- Scot Pollard, forward, Kansas
20. Minnesota (from Charlotte via Portland) -- Paul Grant,
centre, Wisconsin
21. New Jersey (from LA Lakers) -- Anthony Parker, guard,
Bradley (to be traded to Philadelphia according to unconfirmed
reports)
22. Atlanta -- Ed Gray, guard, California
23. Seattle -- Bobby Jackson, guard, Minnesota
24. Houston -- Rodrick Rhodes, forward, Southern California
25. New York -- John Thomas, forward, Minnesota
26. Miami -- Charles Smith, guard, New Mexico
27. Utah -- Jacques Vaughn, guard, Kansas
28. Chicago -- Keith Booth, forward, Maryland
